hypothesis: The Clark-Hash correction can be fused with the exact 1.5-bit half-support tail kernel for Qwen3.8-27B vision FC2 layers in one native CPU call while retaining at least 95 percent of tail-only AVX2 throughput, agreeing with explicit T x plus A times R x within 5e-4 absolute error, and keeping the complete independently aligned component at no more than 1.58 bits per weight

scope.claim_boundary: synthetic exact-support and learned-route data on the real vision FC2 shape; not real-weight approximation quality, model capability, token throughput, semi-lossless compression, or a scientific breakthrough

formula.weight_approximation: W approximately equals T plus A R
formula.runtime: y equals T x plus A times R x
formula.ternary_runtime: 33 byte-compatible mask64 groups plus one exact width-80 half-support tail with row-anchor scale4
formula.route: one bucket and sign per input coordinate; R x is computed once from groupwise-dequantized Q8 activation
formula.correction: signed INT4 A with one FP16 scale per output row
formula.fusion_boundary: one public C call with a 34-float projection scratch and 1152-float correction scratch; no dense residual is materialized

measurement.ternary_codes: deterministic synthetic exact-half-support codes in every full and tail group
measurement.route: deterministic synthetic one-sparse signed routing with the exact learned-route dimensions
measurement.correction_codes: deterministic signed INT4 in [-7,7] with FP16 row scales
measurement.activation: deterministic signed INT8 with 34 per-group FP32 scales
measurement.threading: one process pinned to one physical CPU; kernels are single-threaded
measurement.comparison: one-call fused AVX2 BMI2 kernel versus the identical half-support tail AVX2 BMI2 base call without correction
measurement.timing_order: base and fused calls are paired and alternated for every repetition
measurement.compiler: system C compiler with C11 O3 Wall Wextra Werror shared PIC and mtune=native

promotion_rules: the real 1152-by-4304 shape must meet correctness storage and fused-overhead thresholds
the control and candidate must use identical half-support codes scales and activation
the correction must be checked against an explicit dequantized T x plus A times R x oracle
a pass closes only the fused runtime gap for even-tail tensors in the projected complete ledger
real learned routes coefficients model weights capability and end-to-end token throughput require separate gates
a failed gate remains a terminal useful result and requires a separately versioned optimization
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
Qwen 4B compute is forbidden in this research lane
this benchmark cannot establish semi-lossless compression or a scientific breakthrough
